name: airship_vectored_independent
title: Generic Airship (Independent Vectoring)
notes: The committed generic family, as a spec: airship_family_gen.py --check regenerates it from this file and diffs the result against the tree. Since 2026-10-08 a 7 m outdoor hull of the Aero Drum Ltd 7 m RC blimp class (7 x 2 m, 14 m^3, polyurethane 100 um, lift capacity 2-2.5 kg; that vehicle has one collective tilt axis, four fixed foam fins and a lower-fin yaw motor), drawn as the 7.0 x 2.0 m spheroid, 14.66 m^3, 18.0 kg neutrally buoyant. Actuation is this project's: two independently tilting pods, four fins. ASSUMED: pod thrust 10 N, pod masses and station, gondola box; the gondola mass 11.37 kg is what neutral buoyancy leaves after the envelope at the earlier hulls' 0.1312 kg/m^2 and the fins. The pods' radii of gyration follow the 10.97 m reference scaled by length.
